segments.text: Ok so, this is the writing agent state page in the CopilotKit docs, for AG2, and I have implemented this page.
This is my project, this is the exact code from the doc, the agent and the page with the toggle button.
Moving on to the demo. After toggling, the page showed the language as Spanish, but umm, when I asked the agent which language to use, it still said English.
So this is the set state call the page tells you to use.
And here it says the agent will match the state, which doesn't happen.
Basically, the UI writes the language, but the agent never sees it. It answers in English every time, and on some runs the UI even flips back to English.
So yeah, please take a look and fix this.
